changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Remove the trailing SQL terminator so Fineract can wrap the report query for pagination, preserving multiselect and empty-office scope.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH source_office_labels(external_id, source_name) AS ( VALUES ('1'::VARCHAR, 'AGENCIA CENTRAL'::VARCHAR), ('2'::VARCHAR, 'USULUTAN'::VARCHAR) ), selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id, COALESCE(source_label.source_name, UPPER(office_under.name)) AS name, office_under.external_id, office_under.hierarchy FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' LEFT JOIN source_office_labels source_label ON source_label.external_id = office_under.external_id WHERE credesal_report_office_is_root( selected_office.id, '${officeId}', '${currentUserHierarchy}' ) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' AND office_under.external_id IS NOT NULL ), eligible_entries AS ( SELECT journal_entry.office_id, journal_entry.account_id, journal_entry.entry_date, journal_entry.type_enum, journal_entry.amount FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry JOIN selected_offices office ON office.id = journal_entry.office_id AND office.external_id = journal_entry.dimensions ->> 'office' WHERE journal_entry.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND jsonb_typeof(journal_entry.dimensions -> 'office') = 'string' ), visible_families AS ( SELECT DISTINCT entry.office_id, LEFT(account.gl_code, 3) AS family_code FROM eligible_entries entry JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = entry.account_id ), daily_movements AS ( SELECT entry.office_id, LEFT(account.gl_code, 3) AS family_code, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN entry.type_enum = 2 THEN entry.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS debit, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN entry.type_enum = 1 THEN entry.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS credit FROM eligible_entries entry JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = entry.account_id WHERE entry.entry_date = CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) GROUP BY entry.office_id, LEFT(account.gl_code, 3) ), family_rows AS ( SELECT office.hierarchy AS office_hierarchy, office.id AS office_id, office.name AS office_name, office.external_id AS office_external_id, family.family_code, family_account.name AS family_name, COALESCE(movement.debit, 0.00) AS debit, COALESCE(movement.credit, 0.00) AS credit FROM visible_families family JOIN selected_offices office ON office.id = family.office_id JOIN acc_gl_account family_account ON family_account.gl_code = family.family_code LEFT JOIN daily_movements movement ON movement.office_id = family.office_id AND movement.family_code = family.family_code ), branch_totals AS ( SELECT office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, office_external_id, SUM(debit) AS debit, SUM(credit) AS credit FROM family_rows GROUP BY office_hierarchy, office_id, office_name, office_external_id ), display_rows AS ( SELECT family.office_hierarchy, family.office_id, family.office_name, family.office_external_id, 1 AS row_order, family.family_code AS account_order, 'CUENTA'::VARCHAR AS row_type, family.family_code AS account_code, family.family_name AS description, family.debit, family.credit FROM family_rows family
UNION ALL
SELECT total.office_hierarchy, total.office_id, total.office_name, total.office_external_id, 2, '~~~~', 'TOTAL_SUCURSAL', NULL, 'Total por Sucursal', total.debit, total.credit FROM branch_totals total
UNION ALL
SELECT '~~~~', NULL, NULL, NULL, 3, '~~~~', 'TOTAL_GENERAL', NULL, 'Total General', SUM(total.debit), SUM(total.credit) FROM branch_totals total ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY office_hierarchy COLLATE "C", row_order, account_order COLLATE "C" ) AS "Orden", row_type AS "Tipo Fila", office_id AS "Id Oficina", office_external_id AS "Código Sucursal", office_name AS "Sucursal", account_code AS "Cuenta", description AS "Concepto", debit AS "Cargos", credit AS "Abonos", CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AS "Fecha" FROM display_rows ORDER BY office_hierarchy COLLATE "C", row_order, account_order COLLATE "C" $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Concentración de Movimientos Diarios';
